prompt: A game shop icon sprite sheet with exactly twelve separate item illustrations arranged in a clean grid of 4 columns and 3 rows with wide empty gaps between them, on a plain solid pure white background. No borders, no panels, no frames, no labels, no text, no letters, no numbers, no ground shadows larger than the item. Art style for every item: soft hand-drawn storybook illustration, thin dark brown outlines, gentle watercolor and colored-pencil shading with subtle paper grain, warm muted colors. Each item is centered in its own cell, all items about the same visual size, nothing overlapping, nothing touching the image edges or crossing into another cell. Row 1, left to right: (1) a small pile of three bright blue faceted diamond gems; (2) a brown cloth pouch tipped over with many bright blue diamond gems spilling out; (3) an open wooden treasure chest overflowing with bright blue diamond gems, sparkling; (4) a round gold military medal hanging from a red and white striped ribbon. Row 2, left to right: (5) one orange-gold raffle ticket with a small star printed on it; (6) a fan of five orange-gold raffle tickets tied with a red band; (7) a single glowing orange-yellow lightning bolt; (8) an olive-green ammo box filled with five glowing orange-yellow lightning bolts. Row 3, left to right: (9) an olive-green wooden military supply crate with gold corner trim and a yellow star on the front, lid closed, a soft glow around it; (10) a stack of three olive-green military supply crates with gold corner trim and yellow stars, the top one slightly open with golden light shining out; (11) a cream-colored gift box tied with a red ribbon bow; (12) a cute anthropomorphic puppy soldier shopkeeper: a fluffy tan-and-cream Jindo-style puppy with pointy ears poking out through a round helmet with an olive-brown camouflage cover, wearing a matching camouflage uniform, standing upright and waving one paw happily. Original design, no insignia, no emblems, no flags.
